cases.name: foreach-break
cases.body:
var b=buffer(3)
bufferWrite(&mut b,0,5)
bufferWrite(&mut b,1,7)
bufferWrite(&mut b,2,9)
var total=0
foreach(let x in &b)
{
total+=x
break
}
return total
cases.cs: var b=new[]{5,7,9}; int total=0; foreach(int x in b){total+=x; break;} return total;

cases.name: foreach-continue
cases.cs: var b=new[]{5,7,9}; int total=0; foreach(int x in b){if(x==7){continue;} total+=x;} return total;

cases.name: foreach-nested

cases.name: foreach-block-body
